package.description: Locally hosted controller for a SolaX hybrid inverter and EV charger, over Modbus TCP.

en-US.description: Locally hosted controller for a SolaX hybrid inverter and EV charger, over Modbus TCP.
en-US.longDescription:
A standalone background service for managing and monitoring a SolaX X3-HYB-G4 PRO hybrid inverter and a SolaX X1/X3-HAC EV charger. It operates entirely within the local network over Modbus TCP, with no cloud dependency, so polling is immediate and the data stays on the premises.
It reads PV generation, battery state of charge and grid power flow, and uses them to drive EV charging and home-battery use from household surplus: charging the car on live solar, holding the battery back when the forecast says it will be needed, and targeting a departure time. A web UI is built in, and it can publish itself to Home Assistant over MQTT.
The built-in web interface requires a password. A fresh installation serves only the page that asks you to set one, and shows no history and no controls until you have; it then asks you to sign in. Authentication can be switched off deliberately for an isolated network, which is not the default. The interface speaks plain HTTP, so it belongs on a network you trust or behind a TLS proxy.
This build is free for any noncommercial purpose under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. Commercial use requires a separate licence -- see the LICENSE file.
en-US.name: Gleanvolt
en-US.releaseNotes:
Install
Debian, Ubuntu, Raspberry Pi OS (64-bit)
Installs the controller and its web UI as a systemd service, started with the default
configuration. Run it again to upgrade; settings and data are kept.
curl -fsSL https://github.com/mpospisil/gleanvolt/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sudo sh
Or by hand, choosing amd64 or arm64:
wget https://github.com/mpospisil/gleanvolt/releases/download/v1.1.0/gleanvolt_1.1.0_arm64.deb
sudo apt install ./gleanvolt_1.1.0_arm64.deb
Then open http://<device>:8090 and set your inverter and charger addresses in
/etc/gleanvolt/gleanvolt.env.
Docker
docker pull ghcr.io/mpospisil/gleanvolt:1.1.0
Or download a self-contained build below and run it — no .NET installation needed.
gleanvolt-1.1.0-win-x64.zip for Windows, linux-arm64 for a Raspberry Pi,
linux-x64 for an x64 Linux host or NAS.
The .nupkg files are the libraries, for building on the controller directly.
They are attached here rather than pushed to a feed.
Verify your download
SHA256SUMS covers every file here. From the directory you downloaded into:
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS
--ignore-missing because you have probably taken one file rather than all of them.
On Windows, without installing anything:
Get-FileHash gleanvolt-1.1.0-win-x64.zip -Algorithm SHA256
and compare it with the line in SHA256SUMS. PowerShell prints the hash in upper case;
the file lists it in lower case, and they are the same hash.
Each zip, .deb, install.sh and .nupkg also carries a build provenance attestation, which says
which workflow run and which commit produced it rather than only that the bytes are
unchanged. That needs no trust in this page:
gh attestation verify gleanvolt-1.1.0-linux-arm64.zip --repo mpospisil/gleanvolt
Changes
- Release smoke test: configure a location and no password, so it is not in setup mode (#326)
- Supported PV systems: Dražice inverters as rebadged SolaX (#315)
- Supported PV systems: Manufacturer column on the inverter and charger tables (#314)
- Restart from the web UI applies settings without a supervisor (in-process restart) (#313)
- Settings and wizard: tips that say what each field means, and Reveal for typed passwords (#312)
- Setup 3: the command-line route (#303) (#311)
- API keys created on Settings: 24 letters and digits instead of 64 hex (#310)
- Setup 2: Home Assistant (MQTT) and the API on Settings and in the wizard (#302) (#309)
- Setup 2 wizard (#308)
- Setup 2: the weather key on Settings and in the wizard (#302) (#307)
- Setup 2: web setup wizard with device discovery, and the hybrid gate (#302) (#306)
- Setup 1: setup mode instead of a startup failure, and password reset (#301) (#305)
- Setup 0: no reference site in the shipped defaults (#300) (#304)
- Solar: a battery that stops taking charge short of the gate counts as full (#298)
- L10n: Czech terms for the controller, the rest level and the solar forecast (#297)
- L10n: simpler, correct Czech and English in the web UI (#296)
- L10n: the web UI in Czech (#291) (#295)
- i18n, part 2: the rest of the service text, and stored phrases read back (#292) (#294)
- The web UI is translatable; the services stay invariant (#290) (#293)
- Container networking: the host network, and a broker on any device (#268) (#289)
- Sun only on a targeted charge, from the web UI and Home Assistant (#251) (#288)
- Settings: the Solcast account, entered and applied without a restart (#286) (#287)
- Settings: the redesign's info tips, restart banner and SolaX phase names (#255) (#285)
- Session energy starts afresh on an unplug in Off (#283) (#284)
- Forecasted, until full: one session over several days (#279) (#282)
- Every mode waits and ends the same way (#280) (#281)
- Charging plan: the redesign's info tips (#255) (#278)
- Overview: the redesign's info tips, session card and car stats (#255) (#277)
- Fast and SolarGrid can wait for low tariff (#274) (#276)
- The grid tariff: providers, the table on Settings, and where it shows (#273) (#275)
- Breaking: the HTTP API carries base units only (#263, step 3) (#272)
- One base unit per quantity below the UI (#263, step 2) (#271)
- One formatter for units in the web UI (#263, step 1) (#270)
- Find the SolaX devices on the LAN: gleanvolt-discover (#267, step 1) (#269)
- A password set on /setup unlocks the settings without a restart (#254) (#266)
- Forecasted never arms the battery hold (#264)
- Seven links: Overview, and Settings for the installation and health (#255) (#262)
- Finish the Classical restyle on the remaining pages (#255) (#261)
- Show the Targeted preview as Classical's 1d dialog (#255) (#260)
- Lay the dashboard out as the Classical overview (#255) (#259)
- Restyle sign-in as Classical's centred card, with the error on the field (#255) (#258)
- Restyle the web UI's foundation to the Classical design system (#255) (#256)
- Anchor the static-assets manifest to the content root only for a single-file publish (#252 follow-up) (#257)
- A Nano Server smoke test for WinGet's actual install layout, not an approximation (#253)
